title: docs(pm-dispatch): write the epic working mode (lanes take the children)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1mwcDLoNPHAa92Ln1roW3J)_

Fixes #31502

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把已裁的专题工作方式写进座位规则。专题 = 父单 + 里程碑表 + 负责车道;子卡用 sub-issue 挂上、住各车道队列、默认不打 `pm:epic`,先后靠 `Blocked-by:`;只拆当前和下一个里程碑;暂停(当前与下个里程碑子卡挂起,更后里程碑子卡并入表后关闭)、检查点、里程碑间 go/no-go 与 30 天复查;在线专题跑完当前里程碑再迁、孤儿专题即迁;专题次序 = 路线图表,不设每账号上限。`pm:epic` 只留给具名的集中例外,其席位离开必须移交。
- 为什么改:落实 #31502 的两份裁决(记录 6723874343:A′ + 暂停补充 + 第 2、3 点;记录 6724302769:暂停时的子卡去留)。旧规则让每张子卡都挂 `pm:epic`、由专职专题席保留,席位一走子卡就被锁死(#8345 停了三天)。
- 风险与回滚:只改席位读的规则文字,不动任何脚本、门禁或标签;两个文件行数不变(98/98、88/88),为此删掉了被新规则取代的旧模式行和一行在别处已有的重复文字。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`seat-lifecycle.md` L52–63(新〈Epic 子树车道〉)、`seat-post-protocol.md` L67–76(收尾与集中例外),以及下文「解读」一节(默认父单挂 `tracking`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期两个都 exit 0,两个文件行数不超上限、无超 120 字节行、无卡号。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,待契约档复核)。

## What changes

Three files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`, line-neutral in each.

- **`seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉 (L52–63, 98 → 98, ceiling 98).** The twelve old-mode bullets (every child reserved with `pm:epic`, never `pm:queue`, a dedicated epic PM per subtree) are replaced by the ruled mode: epic = parent + milestone table + owning lane (L52); the template (L53); the parent's labels (L54); children as sub-issues in the lane queues with no `pm:epic` by default, ordered only by `Blocked-by:` (L55); rolling split plus the go/no-go for high-risk epics (L56); the roadmap order and no per-account cap (L57); the pause rules (L58–62); the concentration exception and the pointer to its details (L63).
- **`seat-post-protocol.md` (88 → 88, ceiling 88).** 〈Epic 车道收尾与僵尸回收〉 becomes 〈Epic 收尾与集中例外〉 (L67–76): closure (L69), the transition for live epics (L70), the exception's delegation shape (L71–73, the old paired signal, kept whole), the mandatory hand-over (L74), zombie recovery now does the hand-over's default arm (L75), and the territory line (L76).
- **`triage-duties.md` (100 → 100).** L67: a cross-layer parent is filed with `area:*` + `tracking` instead of `area:*` + `pm:epic`. L66: a parent that already has children gets `tracking`, not a queue label, and triage routes the children one by one with `Blocked-by:`. L74: a tracking parent's children are counted by sub-issue, not by `Part of` prose.
- **Template, smallest form:** one prose line naming #27293's four columns (`Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane`, one row group per milestone, a child cell is the card number plus one sentence). Both files pin zero markdown table rows (`MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` is 0 for each), so a table is not available there.

### Ruling item → file:line

| Ruled item (record 6723874343) | Where |
|:--|:--|
| A′ 1 parent + milestone table + owning lane | seat-lifecycle L52, L53 (template), L54; triage-duties L66, L67 |

### Line payment (deleted text and its survivors)

- Old seat-lifecycle L59 (`pm:epic` + `pm:queue` on one card is a half state) survives at `SKILL.md:116` ("⛔ 永不与 `pm:queue` 同挂") and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H45.
- Old seat-lifecycle L57 (full claim discipline) survives at `AGENTS.md:394-411`; L62's per-routing audit comment at `triage-duties.md:68`; L62's checklist summary comment is replaced by the milestone table (ruled).
- Old seat-lifecycle L61 (spec sub-issues go to the spec seat queue) and L60 (single-lane repo claim shortcut) are old-mode lines the ruled default replaces: every child now lives in its lane queue.
- Old seat-post-protocol L74 (in-flight claims are followed by their claimant) survives at `SKILL.md:105` (在飞卡跟到 MERGED).
- Old seat-lifecycle L56's second half (successor `pm:blocked` until the predecessor closes, released by the unlock sweep) survives at `SKILL.md:110`; that paid the fifth pause line ruling 6724302769 added.
- seat-post-protocol L32 ("PR 正文不送页脚: relay `issue_patch` stores what it is sent") survives at `platform-readings.md:335` and `platform-readings.md:343`.
- No re-wrap, no sentence split across two bullets, every touched line ≤ 120 B.

### Interpretation (agreed with the seat before writing; please judge it)

The ruling says children carry no `pm:epic` by default and `pm:epic` is only for a named exception; it does not name the default parent's labels. This PR reads it as: the default parent carries `tracking` + `area:*`, no pm state label and no `pm:epic`, and is never dispatched; a concentration exception keeps the old delegation shape whole (parent `pm:epic` + session registration + territory, only the named chain reserved). Measured script facts behind it, none changed:

- `check-half-states.mjs` H45 reads every `pm:epic` carrier: a top-level one with sub-issues or a `session_` registration is clean, and a `pm:epic` child whose parent lacks `pm:epic` is a finding. So the exception must put `pm:epic` on the parent, and a default parent without it trips nothing.
- `fleet-roster.mjs` (L30–42, L286–297) builds an epic row only from an open `pm:epic` parent with sub-issues and a registration, so default epics show no seat row, which matches "no default epic seat".
- `tracking` is the existing H13- and H74-exempt "stays open by design" label (`TRACKING_ANCHOR_LABEL`), excluded from triage's sweep at `triage-duties.md:15`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not changed, by order:** the four scripts that read `pm:epic` (`check-half-states.mjs`, `fleet-roster.mjs`, `mailbox-open.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`). None enforces the old mode against the ruling (details in the report's `out_of_scope_findings`). Moving live epics (#8345 and others) is triage's; cloud#3823 / cloud#3820 and every cloud file are out of scope.
- Review nits: the closure line no longer removes `pm:epic` on close (`close-cards.mjs` keeps identity stickers); "每日看板" at L57 is the ruling's own wording ("the daily dashboard") and is left, since naming an owner for it is not in either ruling.
- `SKILL.md:54`, `SKILL.md:116` and `project-forms.md:36` describe `pm:epic` / `epic:#N#K` seats and stay true for the exception, so they are unchanged.
- Tier S (`.claude/**`): lands after a contract-tier review of record for the head; the seat routes it. `skip-changeset`: nothing here publishes.

## Verification

Derived gate set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`) at the head `88e8137a`: 19 derived, 19 run, all exit 0 (ratchet and id-lint among them); `--ran` reconciliation 19/19, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The first round ran the same 19 at `3865f7ce`. Full log in the os-dev report on the card.
